googleSearchConsole.reason: Window totals are Search Console by-property site totals. Page-family rows sum page-grouped rows, where one search counts once per URL it shows, so they are not shares of the site total. Query rows come from one Search Console lookup per reviewed query and window, on the reviewed text lowercased with spaces collapsed (28d: 0 of 25 reported, 25 not reported, 0 unavailable; 90d: 0 of 25 reported, 25 not reported, 0 unavailable). A query Search Console does not report has null metrics with that reason: it fell below Google's privacy threshold or had no impressions, which is not a zero. indexedPages counts sitemap-declared HTML URLs that URL Inspection reported indexed when the snapshot ran (2026-11-10); the same count stands in both windows.

bingWebmaster.reason: Query and page-family rows are top-100-per-week sums, not totals; a weekly bucket counts toward a window when the Friday it ends on falls inside it. Query rows exist only for reviewed queries that appear with exact text among the top 20 queries per window; a reviewed query outside that list has no row, which is not a zero. Window totals come from the daily traffic rows, which carry no position, so averagePosition is null at the window and page-family level. indexedPages is Bing's InIndex count on 2026-11-03; the same count stands in both windows.

aiPerformance.reason: Bing Webmaster Tools reports AI Performance (citations and grounding queries) only in its UI; the Webmaster API has no method for it.

referrals.reason: sessions is Umami `visits`, summed over 28 one-day queries, so a visit that spans midnight UTC counts on both days. Umami visitors are visitor-days and are not reported as sessions. dashboardLaunches, pricingViews, signUps, proConversions, activations, apiActions, mcpActions are null: the weekly Umami collection reads no landing-page or event breakdown. The 90d window is null: Umami keeps 30 days of raw events. There are no referrer by landing-page segments: Umami referrer counts are visitor-days with no landing-page dimension. Referrer families, 28d visitor-days by the Umami collector's host rules: chatgpt 6; perplexity 71; google_search_ai unavailable (Google AI Overviews and AI Mode send the same google.com referrer as web search, so a referrer cannot separate them.) [google.com counts as search, google.fr counts as search, gemini.google.com counts as other_ai_search]; copilot_bing 1 [bing.com counts as search]; claude 10; other_ai_search 159; unknown_direct 225922.

opportunities.title: Find out why brand searches click through less often
opportunities.evidence: Search Console 28d brand CTR fell from 59.7% (2026-10-06 to 2026-11-02) to 56.5% (2026-10-13 to 2026-11-09) while brand impressions rose from 62,770 to 68,241 and brand position moved from 1.24 to 1.31. The query "world monitor" fell from 68.4% (18,817 of 27,492) to 63.3% (19,479 of 30,789). The site CTR fell from 16.7% to 14.3% as impressions rose 23.2%: at the earlier week's brand, non-brand and anonymized CTRs, this week's mix gives 15.3%, so the mix explains 1.3 of the 2.3 points and lower CTR inside each segment, led by brand, explains the rest.
opportunities.experiment: By hand, compare the result Google shows for "world monitor" with the homepage title and description, and look for a same-name site, sitelink change or result feature taking the click. Change one thing at a time and note the date. Do not scrape result pages.
opportunities.successCriteria: From 2026-11-17 the reviewed-query rows for q26 "world monitor" and q27 "worldmonitor" are reported every week, and q26 returns to a 28d CTR of at least 68% at position 1.3 or better.

opportunities.title: Get the declined documentation pages indexed or retired
opportunities.evidence: Search Console indexes 345 of the 411 declared documentation URLs (83.9%): 51 crawled and declined, 11 discovered but not crawled, 4 unknown to Google. That is 51 of the site's 53 crawled-and-declined HTML pages; every other family with more than 20 URLs is above 94%. Site-wide, 896 of 972 declared HTML pages are indexed. Bing reports 1,613 URLs in its index, but it counts every URL it holds, not the declared set, so the two numbers are not comparable.
opportunities.experiment: List the 51 crawled-and-declined documentation URLs from the URL Inspection results, then merge, improve or noindex each one, and keep the sitemap to the pages that remain.
opportunities.successCriteria: The Documentation page-family row shows indexed pages rising from 345 toward the declared count, and the site indexedPages rises from 896, with no indexed page lost in other families.

opportunities.title: Rank for "global conflict tracker" with a page built for it
opportunities.evidence: On 2026-11-13, "global conflict tracker" had 499 Search Console impressions and 1 click in the 28 days to 2026-11-12, at position 8.8 (810 impressions at 12.2 over 90 days). Google splits it between the homepage (position 9.4) and the best-global-conflict-trackers-2026 blog post (11.6). The reviewed q08 "live geopolitical crisis tracker with sources" was not reported in either window.
opportunities.experiment: Make one page the answer: name the job in the crises hub title and heading, link it from the homepage and the trackers post, and keep the post as the comparison.
opportunities.successCriteria: The reviewed-query row for q33 "global conflict tracker" reaches position 5 or better with at least 2% CTR over 28d.

opportunities.title: Close the gap between Perplexity and GPT in AI answers
opportunities.evidence: The first weekly answerrank run (2026-11-11) named World Monitor in 13 of 195 model answers. Perplexity named it in 7 of 39 and cited worldmonitor.app in 18 of 39; GPT with web search named it in 0 of 39 and cited it in 4 of 39, and searched in only 19 of 39. Umami counted 71 Perplexity, 10 Claude and 6 ChatGPT visitor-days from 2026-10-13 to 2026-11-09, against 72,938 from search.
opportunities.experiment: For the questions GPT answered with search but without World Monitor, list the pages it cited and make the matching first-party page state the comparison those pages make, with dated sources. Rerun nothing by hand; the weekly answerrank run measures the change.
opportunities.successCriteria: The ChatGPT and Perplexity visitor-days in the scorecard's referral row rise above 6 and 71 per 28 days, and the weekly answerrank snapshot reports GPT web answers citing worldmonitor.app more than 4 of 39 times without a declined verdict.

opportunities.title: Index the developer pages that branded API and MCP searches land on
opportunities.evidence: Search Console indexes 3 of the 4 declared developer/MCP URLs (one crawled and declined); the family had 193 impressions and 10 clicks in the 28 days to 2026-11-09, down from 14 clicks the week before. On 2026-11-13, "world monitor api" had 142 impressions and 84 clicks over 90 days and "world monitor mcp" 108 and 63, both near position 1, while the long developer queries q11-q15 were never reported.
opportunities.experiment: Find the declined developer/MCP URL in the URL Inspection results and fix or retire it, and link /docs/api-reference and /docs/mcp-overview from every developer page.
opportunities.successCriteria: The Developer / MCP page-family row shows 4 of 4 indexed, and from 2026-11-17 the reviewed-query rows for q28 "world monitor api" and q29 "world monitor mcp" are reported every week.

guardrails: Do not automate unauthorized search-result scraping.
Do not treat an AI mention without a worldmonitor.app source link as a direct citation.
Do not claim causal uplift from a single observation.
Do not store personal prompts, account identifiers, or sensitive query context.
Do not convert unavailable data to zero or estimate it from unrelated public results.
Do not expand the content corpus solely because an SEO vendor assigns a score.
Use UTM fields for internal acquisition attribution; ref= remains affiliate attribution.
